# nsdev

> A showcase of the tools I develop, built for advanced developers. Maintained by Njoh Simplice Junior.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nsdev.me/): overview of the tools
- [Contact](https://nsdev.me/contact): contact form
- [Legal notice](https://nsdev.me/legal): publisher, hosting and privacy information

## Tools

- [nsdev/ui](https://ui.nsdev.me): a component library built on Base UI and Tailwind, fully styled, with your own design tokens
